findings.issue: Mis-segmentation: surface でもも is でも (the quoted word 'but') + additive particle も (XもYもない pattern). The split で+もも invented a 'peach' reading that does not exist here and contradicts expl_en/expl_pt and lit_pt.
findings.current: peach (pun word, no real meaning here)
findings.suggested: Re-segment tokens[0-1] as でも ('but', quoted word being mocked) + も ('nor/also', additive particle); delete the 'peach' gloss.

findings.issue: The sentence contains no 'peach': でもも = でも + particle も. lit_en adds a phantom third item and contradicts lit_pt and both expl fields, which correctly list only でも and ヘチマ.
findings.current: There are no 'buts', peaches, or loofahs, you know.
findings.suggested: There are no 'buts' nor loofahs, you know.

findings.issue: ずらかる means 'to scram/flee' (as en/pt/expl correctly say), not 'to come off' (confusion with ずれる/ずらす); the implied subject is 'you', and the 'will it?' tag has no basis in んだ.
findings.current: What... it won't come off, will it?!

findings.issue: もうすぐ means 'very soon', not 'already'; lit_en asserts the car is currently scrap, while jp/en/pt/expl all say it will soon be scrap. Temporal sense changed.
findings.current: As for this car, it's already scrap.
findings.suggested: As for this car, very soon (it's) scrap.

findings.issue: Spurious duplicate tokens: お (tokens[0]) and 兄ちゃん (tokens[1]) are prepended out of order before はい and duplicate the correct merged token お兄ちゃん (tokens[4]); surface reconstruction of the sentence breaks.
findings.current: お / 兄ちゃん (tokens[0]-[1], placed before はい)
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0] お and tokens[1] 兄ちゃん; keep the sequence はい、お兄ちゃん、半分こ。

findings.issue: Duplicate tokens: できる (tokens[0]) and だけ (tokens[1]) precede the merged できるだけ token (tokens[2]), so that stretch of surface is represented twice; reconstruction yields できるだけできるだけ安く….
findings.current: できる / だけ (tokens[0]-[1]) followed by merged できるだけ (tokens[2])
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0] できる and tokens[1] だけ; keep only the merged できるだけ token.

findings.issue: よ itself is gender-neutral; the feminine coloring belongs to the combination のよ. Calling よ 'the emphatic feminine particle' teaches a false generalization about よ.
findings.current: explanatory の + the emphatic feminine particle よ
findings.suggested: explanatory の + emphatic よ; the combination のよ is typical of colloquial feminine speech

findings.issue: Same defect as expl_en (よ is neutral; the feminine coloring is in the combination のよ), plus spelling error 'ênfatica' (correct: 'enfática').
findings.current: a combinação explicativa の + a partícula ênfatica feminina よ
findings.suggested: a combinação do の explicativo + a partícula enfática よ; o conjunto のよ é típico da fala feminina coloquial

findings.issue: 半分こ's こ is the childish suffix marking mutual action ('halfsies between us'), not a diminutive; 'a little half-portion' misreads it and contradicts the (correct) expl fields.
findings.current: Here/take it, big brother (affectionate), a little half-portion.
findings.suggested: Here/take it, big brother (affectionate), half-and-half (split between us).

findings.issue: 'metadezinha' renders こ as a diminutive; in 半分こ, こ marks mutual action ('half for each of us'), as expl_pt itself correctly states.
findings.suggested: Sim/toma, irmão mais velho (carinhoso), metade-a-metade (entre nós).

findings.issue: Typo in both note locales: the passive base of つなぐ is つなが, not つながわ (a nonexistent form).
findings.current: aqui a base つながわ formando つながれ
findings.suggested: aqui a base つなが formando つながれ / here the base つなが forming つながれ

findings.issue: 明日 read as あす clashes with the very casual spoken register (ごめんね…のよ); the natural reading here is あした (あす is formal/broadcast style).
findings.current: ごめんね。あすわあさからぱーとがあるのよ。
findings.suggested: ごめんね。あしたわあさからぱーとがあるのよ。

findings.issue: Same as kana: in this casual spoken sentence 明日 is naturally read あした; あす is register-mismatched (formal/news style).
